‘SYSTEMIC FAILURE’

READ: The Toll Regulatory Board issued a show cause order to NLEX Corp. to explain the flooding on portions of Balintawak and Valenzuela in Quezon City on July 21, which left a number of stranded motorists.

“The recurrence of this specific type of incident demonstrates a systemic failure in improving your tollway monitoring function,” TRB executive director Jose Arturo Tugade said | @bylancemejico

data.text:
Members of Tindig Pilipinas, Nagkaisa, Kalipunan, SIKLAB, and the citizens who filed the impeachment complaint gathered at the Boy Scout Circle in Quezon City on Saturday, July 26, to voice their outrage over the Supreme Court’s dismissal of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

The groups led a protest and noise barrage to express what they called a resounding show of frustration and dissent over the high court’s ruling.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB

data.text:
NOISE BARRAGE HELD IN QC TO PROTEST SC RULING ON VP IMPEACHMENT 

WATCH: Tindig Pilipinas, Nagkaisa, Kalipunan, SIKLAB, and the impeachment complainants held a rally and noise barrage at the Boy Scout Circle in Quezon City on Saturday, July 26.

The groups expressed strong disappointment and opposition to the Supreme Court’s decision junking the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte. According to organizers, the protest aimed to show the public’s frustration over what they called a failure of accountability and justice. | via Jonas Sulit, @DWAR1494
